          p "Use Origin Shield to restrict inbound traffic to your origin servers exclusively from Azion's trusted IP addresses. The dynamic Network List is maintained by Azion and updated automatically. Configure your origin's firewall to accept only Origin Shield addresses, establishing a Layer 3/4 perimeter that blocks all direct external access."
          img "Origin Shield architecture showing trusted Azion IP addresses connecting to origin servers"
